calls.thesis: Kaplan: Illumina 'now is the time to buy' — botched Grail acquisition chapter closed, guidance raised, back in S&P 500 last month; the 'shovel' (sequencers + recurring reagent kits) behind every biotech trial; $41B mkt cap, up 160% from last year's low.
calls.bull_case: Benefits from every trial in the report; exponential growth in sequencing demand.
calls.bear_case: Mixed analyst views — some say it's run ahead of itself.
